title: Start a shift
goal: Work out what you can get done now and what needs attention before it can proceed.
context: You have just opened the shop's fulfilment queue. You can ask the assistant questions and use the application's controls.
completion: You can explain what you would work on, what you would leave, and the reasons for those decisions.
variations: Ask a follow-up about one exclusion.
Compare the assistant's explanation with the order details.
